concurrent completed-match restarts admit one writer and reject the stale contender without writes
completed-match restart rolls room, match, receipt, players, and outbox back together
fresh Miniflare D1 runtimes are isolated and persisted receipts survive repository recreation
unsupported state schema is returned as a safe recovery error
D1 invite limiter persists reservations across limiter instances and admits at most five
D1 invite limiter success JOIN reset clears prior failures and retry backoff
same-version concurrent room mutations write one player row and one receipt
room, player, receipt, and outbox writes roll back together on statement failure
malformed state JSON fails schema validation before it can be written
stored snapshot validation checks catalog enums and every resolution record shape

fresh D1 bootstraps concurrently, records one checksummed migration and optimizes indexes
